verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a simulator, so its own contribution to bring-up is a simulated version of the robot. It offers ready-made robot models (PR2, TurtleBot, etc.) and copyable SDF snippets from Fuel, example worlds to modify, custom robot-control plugins, sensor simulation, and a one-command ros_gz install for ROS integration. This can speed up configuration and first motion in simulation, but nothing in the evidence covers bringing up real hardware or the hours-versus-weeks claim. Missing for 10: physical hardware driver bring-up, a documented new-robot onboarding workflow, evidence of time-to-first-motion, independent or hands-on corroboration.
